description: This file defines an Android activity named NotesListActivity, responsible for displaying a list of notes, handling user interactions such as adding or editing notes, performing search, and showing synchronization status.

classes.name: NotesListActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a list of notes with functionalities for adding, editing, searching, and syncing notes.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components, adapter, search listener, and launches a coroutine to observe ViewModel state.

methods.description: Handles menu item selection, triggering sync when the sync action is selected.
